D = -0.172, CI [-0.230, -0.142], so the fixed rule wins. L5a repeats this for the shipped LearnedAllocator: D = -0.454, with both CIs below 0. E03: D(ts_online) = -0.172, CI [-0.230, -0.142]. L5a: D = -0.454, CI [-0.472, -0.361]. Both favor the fixed rule, so claim 2 is not_supported, and the free-label confound is controlled, so W2 is false. Claim 3: every entry uses E01's model, task and proxy, so no non-E01 entry can trigger the kill rule. No non-E01 entry shows an embedding gain of at least 0.05 or a neighbor ratio of at least 1.5. So c3 is open, and W3 is false because the ledger doesn't conclude claim 3 is supported.
